verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs list GGUF among its supported quantization formats, so the capability is first-party. The evidence is only a single feature-list mention, with no detail on how GGUF files are loaded and served or what limits apply. missing for 10: documentation of the GGUF loading workflow (e.g. pointing serve at a .gguf file or tokenizer handling), supported architectures and quant types for GGUF, known limitations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format

citations.quote: Quantization: FP8, MXFP8/MXFP4, NVFP4, INT8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF, compressed-tensors, ModelOpt, TorchAO, and more
Quantization trades off model precision for smaller memory footprint, allowing large models to be run on a wider range of devices.
